notes: *have* is placed on the possessive `לְ` under rule 43: the clause is verbless, no `הָיָה` and no existential particle stands in it, and the preposition is what makes it possessive.
*This* is the written `הוּא`'s under rule 18: the referent's own noun `הָדָר` stands written in the clause, so the pronoun takes only the determiner the ASV writes for it.

`חֲסִידָיו` carries a written possessive, so the phrase needs no supplied determiner and the adjective takes only *saints*; the suffix takes *his* under rule 18, MACULA's reversed gloss distribution being a display defect under rule 39.
The margin's 'Or, He is the honor of all his saints' would have kept the clause copular; it was read and set aside, licensing no target token, by rule 38.
`הַלְלוּ יָהּ` closes the psalm as it opened it and is split on the same terms as PSA.149.1.
